qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Merchant acquiring and card issuing network benefits from bank-partner distribution and Italian domestic scale, but lacks pricing power against modern platforms (Adyen, Stripe) and fails on sub-8% GAAP ROIC resulting from massive debt-funded goodwill (Nets and SIA mergers).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power). Legacy European payment processor created via debt-funded rollups (Nets, SIA); suffers from sub-hurdle GAAP ROIC (~5-7%), billions in goodwill, high financial leverage (~€5.2B net debt), and persistent take-rate pressure from modern competitors like Adyen.
qualitative.evidence: GAAP ROIC averages ~5-7%, severely depressed by ~€18B-19B in invested capital following the Nets and SIA mergers. Statutory results saw heavy impairments and low net income (€171M in 2024 vs large net loss in 2023). High net debt of €5.2B (2.7x EBITDA) limits financial flexibility while merchant acquiring faces secular fee compression from tech-native payment platforms.
